summary: Spec'd climb shared-replay transport (pause/play, rewind 5s / seek, speeds 1×/2×/4×, keyboard scoped) and client-side video export (720×1280@30fps, MP4-preferred with honest WebM fallback, progress/cancel/failures). 20 testable ACs in loop/spec.md. nextStage: architect (design-ux not required first — DESIGN.md tokens suffice).
goal: Climb replay should allow fast forwarding, rewind, pause/play. Export as mp4.

learnings.insight: Replay transport shortcuts (Space/k, J, L) must reuse the same interactive-target exemption pattern as shouldCaptureGameKey: never preventDefault or change playback when focus is on button/link/form controls, or mute/Start regress again.
learnings.action: Wire replay shortcut listeners through a testable predicate that returns false for interactive targets and for non-replay sessions; add AC-3 negative coverage in verifier.

learnings.insight: Rewind/seek on a deterministic input-log replay is a resim-to-tick problem (O(N) naively up to 18000 ticks). Product requires visual parity with headless stepMatch and ≤500ms seek paint, not a specific cache design.
learnings.action: Architect should decide snapshot interval or incremental cache in loop/architecture.md; do not mutate live-play useClimb hot path when replaying===false (NFR-8).

learnings.insight: User-facing 'Export as MP4' cannot mean 'always MP4' across browsers: MediaRecorder MIME support is uneven. Spec requires format-honest filenames and UI labels plus a WebM (or equivalent) fallback path.
learnings.action: Implement MIME negotiation with explicit success copy ('Downloaded MP4' vs 'Downloaded WebM') and AC-17 unsupported path; do not silently rename WebM to .mp4.

learnings.insight: Product-spec for replay transport+export defines 20 mechanically testable ACs (AC-1…AC-20) covering controls, export, negatives for live-play regression, MediaRecorder absence, and reduced motion.
learnings.action: Map each AC to an invoked unit or browser check; reject source-text grep proofs. Headless stepMatch parity is the oracle for AC-6.

learnings.insight: Pre-existing free-leaderboard trust-boundary ping remains open and is explicitly out of scope for replay transport/export; this spec does not accept or close it.
learnings.action: Do not treat this handoff as resolving AC-17/server-derived peaks for free play. Keep the ledger open question until a dedicated goal scopes it.

openQuestions: Audio mux in export (deferred to Future; v1 silent).

notes.designUxRationale: ASCENT tokens and control patterns in app/DESIGN.md are sufficient; optional design-ux polish after first implementation if transport chrome needs a visual pass.
